Stage 1 Speculative Bet 44 stocks

This section lists every stock that passes the Stage 1 Speculative Bet's Stage 1 (basing) rating test and rates Possible or better on it; a stock can appear in more than one section.

What the tests are. The Stage 1 Speculative Bet has seven tests, and a stock that passes them all (with either of the two upturn tests) is Qualified. The first test needs the stock's Stage 1 (basing) rating to be Plausible or Probable. The second and third tests need the 5D and the 10D moving averages each to be higher than the day before. The fourth test needs the close to be above the 20D moving average. The fifth and sixth tests look for a fresh upturn: the 20D or the 50D moving average rising today after falling five sessions earlier, and either one is enough. The seventh test needs the close to be at least 2% above the prior close, which confirms the move. The Stage 1 Speculative Bet rates None if any of the first three tests fails, Plausible with either the fourth test or an upturn, Probable with both, and Qualified with both plus the seventh.

Stage 2 Probing Bet 72 stocks

This section lists every stock that passes the Stage 2 Probing Bet's Stage 2 (uptrend) rating test and rates Possible or better on it; a stock can appear in more than one section.

What the tests are. The Stage 2 Probing Bet has six tests, and a stock that passes all six is Qualified. The first test needs the stock's Stage 2 (uptrend) rating to be Plausible or Probable. The second and third tests need the 5D and the 10D moving averages each to be higher than the day before. The fourth test needs the close to be above the 50D moving average. The fifth test needs a fresh upturn: the 50D moving average rising today after falling five sessions earlier. The sixth test needs the close to be at least 2% above the prior close, which confirms the move. The Stage 2 Probing Bet rates None if any of the first three tests fails, Plausible with either the fourth or the fifth test, Probable with both, and Qualified with both plus the sixth.

Stage 3 Speculative Bet 61 stocks

Late Innings Speculative Bets are named but not bought under the current Position Entry and Exit Rules, so this section is for information.

This section lists every stock that passes the Stage 3 Speculative Bet's Stage 3 (topping) rating test and rates Possible or better on it; a stock can appear in more than one section.

What the tests are. The Stage 3 Speculative Bet has seven tests, and a stock that passes them all (with either of the two upturn tests) is Qualified. The first test needs the stock's Stage 3 (topping) rating to be any rating above None. The second and third tests need the 5D and the 10D moving averages each to be higher than the day before. The fourth test needs the close to be above the 20D moving average. The fifth and sixth tests look for a fresh upturn: the 20D or the 50D moving average rising today after falling five sessions earlier, and either one is enough. The seventh test needs the close to be at least 2% above the prior close, which confirms the move. The Stage 3 Speculative Bet rates None if any of the first three tests fails, Plausible with either the fourth test or an upturn, Probable with both, and Qualified with both plus the seventh.

Stage 4 Speculative Bet 26 stocks

Late Innings Speculative Bets are named but not bought under the current Position Entry and Exit Rules, so this section is for information.

This section lists every stock that passes the Stage 4 Speculative Bet's Stage 4 (declining) rating test and rates Possible or better on it; a stock can appear in more than one section.

What the tests are. The Stage 4 Speculative Bet has seven tests, and a stock that passes them all (with either of the two upturn tests) is Qualified. The first test needs the stock's Stage 4 (declining) rating to be Plausible or Probable. The second and third tests need the 5D and the 10D moving averages each to be higher than the day before. The fourth test needs the close to be above the 20D moving average. The fifth and sixth tests look for a fresh upturn: the 20D or the 50D moving average rising today after falling five sessions earlier, and either one is enough. The seventh test needs the close to be at least 2% above the prior close, which confirms the move. The Stage 4 Speculative Bet rates None if any of the first three tests fails, Plausible with either the fourth test or an upturn, Probable with both, and Qualified with both plus the seventh.

How this page is built, and what to trust
  • Source: the Master Dashboard's own readings (built 2026-11-14 15:36 UK, on the 14 November 2026 close) decide every tick, cross and rating on this page. The numbers in each cell come from the Master Dashboard's chart prices, with moving averages worked out from the closing prices.
  • Population: every stock whose Interest Lists rating is A. Very desired, B. Desired or C. Lightly interested (RB Interest List A, B and C), plus the Live Stocks in the Position Management System book: 290 stocks with prices. No prices on the Master Dashboard: Glenveagh Properties, Kaspi.kz.
  • Check against the Master Dashboard: this build recomputed every bet for every stock with current prices and found 0 differences from the Master Dashboard's own ratings.
  • Ten-session strips: the same recomputation for each of the last ten sessions, using the Master Dashboard's rating history for the Stage ratings; the last square is the Master Dashboard's reading for the latest close.
  • Watson's guess: 1,000 simulated ten-session price paths per stock, each day's move drawn at random from the stock's own last 250 daily moves, with each bet's tests applied every day and the Stage ratings held as they are. The odds are the share of paths that reach Qualified at least once. Likely means 50% or more, Possible 20% to 50% and Unlikely below 20%. Where the Stage rating test fails, Possible means that Stage rating improved over the fortnight and Unlikely means it did not.
  • Routes in the analysis: "with prices flat in between" means every other day stays at the latest close, and the price quoted is the lowest close that passes on that day.
  • Readings one session or more old: Senior (08-Oct).
  • Rebuilt by master-dashboard/scripts/build_capital_deployment.py 1.0 in every Master Dashboard refresh. Record: projects/APM - Shortlisting of stocks/bet-readiness/.
